class.agency: Philadelphia Water Department (City of Philadelphia civil-service class plan)
class.mqParaphrase: Twelfth grade plus 1 year operating computer-controlled water, wastewater or sludge processing equipment; operator licence or approved coursework may substitute.

licensesRequired.credential: PA DEP water or wastewater operator licence (C-level or higher)

competencyTargets.label: Operate drinking water treatment processes to meet water quality targets
Operate wastewater treatment and resource-recovery processes to permit limits
Practice within licensure scope and responsible charge
Supervise automated and AI-assisted process control in environmental operations
Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities
Manage field sample custody and field quality control
Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings
Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites
Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work
Validate AI-generated work products before professional use
Manage a municipal stormwater programme to meet permit conditions
Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work
Record provenance and AI involvement in work products

topTasks.statement: Adjust coagulant dosing from jar test results when raw-water turbidity, temperature or organic content changes
Verify disinfection contact time against required inactivation values at each operating flow and correct shortfalls before water enters distribution
Adjust aeration and sludge wasting rates using solids inventory, settleability and dissolved-oxygen trends to hold effluent within permit limits
Diagnose a biological process upset from microscopic examination, foam, odor and settling behavior before laboratory results confirm it
Determine whether an assigned task falls within the scope of one's licence or certification, referring out-of-scope work to a qualified professional
Respond to a treatment upset by isolating the affected process unit, bringing backup treatment online and notifying the primacy agency
Route peak wet-weather flows through the plant to protect biological treatment, recording any bypass or overflow for required reporting
Operate anaerobic digestion and solids handling to meet biosolids pathogen-reduction and stability requirements while recovering digester gas
Run a treatment process in safe manual operation when automation or communications fail, adapting the manual operating procedure to conditions
Monitor automated control loops and alarms on a treatment process, checking automated responses against field observations of process condition
Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them

shown.label: Drinking water treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV / Class A-D, state-specific)
